fields.name: census_year
fields.description: The CLUE census year refers to the year in which surveying was completed.
fields.label: Census year

fields.name: block_id
fields.description: The Census area is divided into city blocks, each of which is identified by a unique block number. Blocks are primarily defined by major roads. There are around 606 blocks in the City of Melbourne.
fields.label: Block ID

fields.name: property_id
fields.description: Property ID is the optional second tier in the property hierarchy, is an individual key use to identify when multiple buildings are located within the boundary of a Base Property ID.
fields.label: Property ID

fields.name: base_property_id
fields.description: Base Property ID is an individual key use to identify each land parcel which is a space (not a street or road) capable of being the parent property of either a Building Property or an occupancy property, the base is the first tier in the property hierarchy.
fields.label: Base property ID

fields.name: building_address
fields.description: Street Address of the Property ID
fields.label: Building address

fields.name: clue_small_area
fields.description: CLUE small areas are composed of a group of city blocks, each of which is identified by a unique block number.
fields.label: CLUE small area

fields.name: trading_name
fields.description: Trading name of the business establishment.
fields.label: Trading name

fields.name: business_address
fields.description: Street Address of the business establishment.
fields.label: Business address

fields.name: industry_anzsic4_code
fields.description: Each establishment in CLUE is classified by an ANZSIC 4 code, allocated to the predominant industry within which it operates using the Australian New Zealand Standard Industrial Classification (ANZSIC) developed by the ABS.
fields.label: Industry (ANZSIC4) code

fields.name: industry_anzsic4_description
fields.description: Each establishment in CLUE is classified by an ANZSIC 4 description, allocated to the predominant industry within which it operates using the Australian New Zealand Standard Industrial Classification (ANZSIC) developed by the ABS.
fields.label: Industry (ANZSIC4) description

fields.name: seating_type
fields.description: A venue where indoor or outdoor seating is provided for commercial use.
fields.label: Seating type

fields.name: number_of_seats
fields.description: The total number of seats in the establishment by seating type.
fields.label: Number of seats

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: The longitude of the cafe or restaurant
fields.label: Longitude

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: The latitude of the cafe or restaurant
fields.label: Latitude

fields.name: location
fields.description: The longitude and latitude of the cafe or restaurant
fields.label: location

default.title: Café, restaurant, bistro seats
default.description:
Data collected as part of the City of Melbourne's Census of Land Use and Employment (CLUE). The data covers the period 2002-2024. It show business establishments with their trading name, business address, industry (ANZSIC4) classification, number of dining seats (classified by indoor/outdoor), location and CLUE block and small area designation.

For more information about CLUE see http://www.melbourne.vic.gov.au/clue
keyword: census of land use and employment

custom.dataset-owner: City of Melbourne Open Data Team

quality.data-quality-statement: A team of census officers conduct field interviews which involves visiting every establishment in every building in the Census area (City of Melbourne municipality). Every commercial property is surveyed at least once every two years.
